exportSummaries.CaseEmotionPolicy: Per-case emotion policy that drives the transition engine.
exportSummaries.ConversationPolicy: Optional injectable conversation policy surface for ScenarioRuntime.
exportSummaries.EmotionEngine: Mutable, stateful wrapper around resolveEmotionTransition for use in a running encounter.
exportSummaries.EmotionEventKind: Kinds of conversation events that can trigger an emotion transition in the standardized-patient / parent actor.
exportSummaries.LearnerSttBargeInRecord: STT barge-in record as consumed by conversation-policy (structural, no voice-gateway import).
exportSummaries.buildHistoryTakingCoverageSpec: Build a per-scenario history-taking coverage spec.
exportSummaries.domainsForTraceTag: Return domain ids whose matchesTraceTags include the given trace tag.
exportSummaries.mapEmotionPerformance: Map the full emotion/style/intensity/age key to one deterministic performance plan.
exportSummaries.stripProviderMarkup: Strip recognized xAI provider markup from generated/ authored text.
exportSummaries.updateHistoryTakingCoverage: Deterministically update coverage from observed trace tags and/or learner utterance keywords.
